hero.title: Protect your company's investment in international talent.
hero.subtitle: MOOVIA supports the executive and family before, during and after relocation and turns human factors into clear indicators for Human Resources and leadership.
hero.microtext: Confidential and compliant with the General Data Protection Regulation.

steps.title: What we do, in three steps
steps.step1_body: We identify the human factors that most influence the adaptation of the executive and family, starting before the move.
steps.step2_body: We transform these factors into practical indicators and recommendations, interpreted by specialists.
steps.step3_body: We measure progress throughout the journey and guide preventive action, without replacing the partners the company already uses.

for_whom.title: Contracted by the company. Experienced by the executive.
for_whom.client_body: Receive aggregated indicators and recommendations to make better decisions on international mobility.
for_whom.exec_body: receives ongoing support and a confidential personal report.

gains.title: What your company gains
gains.item1_body: Identify signals in time to act and reduce turnover risk.
gains.item2_body: Accelerate the adaptation of the executive and family.
gains.item4_body: Protect the investment made in international talent.
gains.support_line: Replacing international talent who failed to adapt costs thousands of euros.

trust.title: Trust and confidentiality
trust.legal_validation_text: The legal model of MOOVIA was analysed by a leading law firm in Portugal, having been considered legally viable, and is currently in the phase of implementing the identified recommendations.
trust.confidentiality_text: The company receives only aggregated indicators. Individual responses and the employee's personal report remain confidential.
trust.gdpr_label: Compliant with the General Data Protection Regulation

final_cta.title: Want to understand how this applies to your company?
final_cta.body: Each proposal is tailored to the profile and complexity of each transition.

methodology.summary_what: A methodology that identifies, measures and tracks the human risk of international mobility throughout the transition.
methodology.summary_who: Contracted by companies relocating executives and families for international assignments.
methodology.summary_benefit: Enables preventive action, accelerates integration and reduces exposure to early turnover.

empresas.opening: International mobility support for companies that invest in talent
empresas.risks_title: The human risks of international mobility
empresas.framework_title: The five stages of the MOOVIA Framework
empresas.framework_step1_body: We understand the human, family and professional context before critical relocation decisions.
empresas.framework_step2_body: We structure readiness indicators and identify key areas requiring attention.
empresas.framework_step3_body: We deliver a clear plan with priorities and practical recommendations to guide the transition.
empresas.framework_step4_body: We monitor adaptation during the first months to adjust support preventively.
empresas.framework_step5_body: We consolidate integration and support the assessment of return on investment.
